price_disclaimer: Price Snapshot Advisory: London hotel rates are highly volatile during the festive championship period (mid-December to early January). Room rates escalate significantly for Friday and Saturday evening sessions, Boxing Day, and New Year's Eve/Finals weekend. Rates shown are indicative base snapshot estimates for a standard double/twin room based on advance direct bookings.

booking_recommendations: Book as soon as your match session is secured in the ticket ballot: Alexandra Palace's festive dates coincide with London Christmas shopping and holiday tourism, creating severe hotel compression.
Prioritize 24-hour reception: Evening darts sessions conclude around 23:00 GMT, meaning arrival back at your hotel often occurs after 23:30 GMT.
Verify flexible cancellation policies: Consider semi-flexible rates that allow free cancellations in case of schedule changes or ticket resale outcomes.
source: Direct Hotel Operator Registries, TfL Journey Planner & Official Visitor Records
